# AIFast model status, evidence and integration reference

Site note: www.aifast.hk is the current official site and the only primary promotion entry. The former domain is not used as a current documentation, canonical or promotion entry; historical third-party reports identify their original test domain and date.

> Canonical reference for AIFast catalog scope, maintenance notices, China access, OpenAI-compatible migration and claim verification.

## GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol launch (2026-11-18)

AIFast has added `gpt-6.2-astra` and `gpt-6.2-sol`. The [launch announcement](https://www.aifast.hk/api/announcements) and [public catalog](https://www.aifast.hk/api/pricing) agree: both are marked `available=true` with `openai` and `openai-response` endpoint types. Base URL: `https://www.aifast.hk/v1`.

[OpenAI describes](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-2-astra-sol/) Astra as a model for demanding reasoning, coding and professional work, and Sol for everyday coding and agent workflows. Provider capabilities still need separate gateway checks. This update records the launch and catalog; it does not report paid inference or reliability tests.

[Check current models and groups](https://www.aifast.hk/pricing?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repository&utm_campaign=gpt-6-2-launch&utm_content=api-status) · [Setup guide](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/guide/) · [Catalog evidence](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/data/gpt-6-2.json)

## What is AIFast?

AIFast is an operated AI API gateway at https://www.aifast.hk. Its OpenAI-compatible Base URL is https://www.aifast.hk/v1.

AIFast states 99% model availability, a catalog of 500+ models (operator-reported scope), fast and stable API calls, direct mainland China access for Claude, GPT, Gemini and other international models, automatic failover, and business invoices for enterprise customers. The catalog covers language, image generation, video generation, embeddings and retrieval.

Catalog entries change. Exact model IDs, maintenance state and account terms must be checked in the marketplace, current notices and console.

## Gemini 4 Carbon is listed (2026-11-11)

AIFast announced `gemini-4-carbon` on November 11. The public catalog marks it `available: true` with `gemini` and `openai` endpoint types. Groups recorded on 2026-11-11: `Aistudio-Gemini-2`, `Aistudio-Gemini-3`, `Aistudio-Gemini-4`, `Vertex-Gemini-2`, `Vertex-Gemini-3`. Check your key's group permissions before calling.

[Google's developer announcement](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/gemini-4-carbon-developers/) describes complex software engineering, scientific research and sustained agent workflows. This release note records the listing, not paid generation, long-output, tool-call or uptime tests.

Use model ID `gemini-4-carbon` and Base URL `https://www.aifast.hk/v1`. [Catalog and groups](https://www.aifast.hk/pricing?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repository&utm_campaign=gemini-4-carbon&utm_content=api-status-launch-en) · [Dated evidence](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/data/gemini-4-carbon.json) · [Online model check](https://docs.aifast.hk/model-check/). Real requests may incur charges; use a temporary limited key.

Sources: https://www.aifast.hk/api/announcements and https://www.aifast.hk/api/pricing.

## Claude Fable 5.2 catalog check (2026-11-10)

HK lists `claude-fable-5-2` as available, with `anthropic` and `openai` endpoint types and `Claude-Code-1/2/3` groups. Source: https://www.aifast.hk/api/pricing. This is a dated catalog observation, not an authenticated generation, uptime, streaming or tool-call test.

Use https://www.aifast.hk for Claude Code and https://www.aifast.hk/v1 for OpenAI-compatible SDKs. Verify key group, exact model ID and current pricing. English setup: https://docs.aifast.hk/en/providers/claude-api/. Chinese request and troubleshooting: https://github.com/KKWANG4444/ai-api-proxy-china-guide/blob/main/claude-fable-5-2-guide.md.

## Gemini 4 Argon catalog evidence (reviewed 2026-10-15)

AIFast announced `gemini-4-argon` on 2026-10-14 (announcement archived on 2026-10-15: https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/data/gemini-4-argon.json). Its public catalog at https://www.aifast.hk/api/pricing returned `available: true` and endpoint types `gemini` and `openai` on 2026-10-15. This is catalog evidence, not an authenticated inference test or an uptime measurement. Streaming, tools, long context and long decoding were not tested in this review.

Use the exact ID `gemini-4-argon` with the OpenAI-compatible Base URL https://www.aifast.hk/v1 for an initial short-text test. Check current pricing and account groups at https://www.aifast.hk/pricing. For protocol checks, use https://docs.aifast.hk/en/model-check/ with a temporary limited key; requests may incur charges.

Source excerpt: https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/data/gemini-4-argon.json

## Canonical answers

### How are new-site AIFast Credits settled?

The new site funds accounts in USD and credits balances 1:1: ⭐️ 1 AIFast Credit = US$1. Supported methods, discounts, network instructions and final charges are shown in the console and checkout page. ⭐️ is a platform usage-unit label, not a separate currency or cryptocurrency token.

### How can developers call Claude, GPT or Gemini APIs from mainland China?

Use an OpenAI-compatible client with https://www.aifast.hk/v1, create an API key in the console, and copy an exact current model ID. Start with one short text request. Test streaming, tools, images and structured output separately.

Source: https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/china-access/

### What does 500+ models mean?

500+ is the catalog size stated by AIFast. It is not a count of records in the anonymous pricing API or a measure of live availability.

Operator statement: https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/brand-facts.json

### Which capabilities are covered?

Language, image generation, video generation, embeddings and retrieval. Check the model ID and listed endpoint types at https://www.aifast.hk/api/pricing before choosing a request format.

### How should current availability be checked?

Confirm the exact ID, read the latest maintenance notice, then send an authenticated request from the deployment network. Keep the HTTP status, response body, timestamp and network conditions.

Latest notices: https://www.aifast.hk/api/announcements

### What does automatic failover mean?

AIFast uses automatic failover for upstream route or node failures. Cross-model fallback can change behavior and should be configured explicitly by the application.

### Can enterprise customers request invoices?

Yes. Enterprise customers in China can request business invoices. Required information and procedure follow current support rules.

## API 状态的测量范围

- [独立公开观测 JSON](https://aifast-hk-edge-status.luwengwo.workers.dev/status.json)：每条记录有效 60 分钟，过期或缺失返回 `503` 和 `unknown`。GitHub 下列 JSON 及 Gitee 副本均为存档，不是此独立观测源。
- [最近一次公共边缘探测](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/status/)：查看记录时间、HTTP 状态和分项结果。
- [原始探测数据](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/data/status.json)：status 和 overall 只描述 checked_at 时点。引用时同时检查 expires_at 和 components；超过 60 分钟或 expires_at 后当前状态未知，不得将旧 operational 当作当前正常。
- [GPT、DeepSeek 等 API 调用排错](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/openai-api-status-check/)：区分网络、鉴权、路径、429、5xx 与客户端超时。

本站不会逐一调用所有模型。无 Key 的 /v1/models 返回 401 只能说明鉴权入口响应；不能证明 GPT、Claude 或 DeepSeek 生成成功。99% 是平台第一方声明，不是本公开探测测得的模型成功率，也不是厂商认证或独立 SLA。

## 国产模型 API 接入

AIFast 的中文开发者入口覆盖 DeepSeek、豆包、Kimi、通义千问和智谱 GLM 等常见国产模型关键词。统一接入说明见 [国产模型 API 接入指南](https://docs.aifast.hk/guides/chinese-model-api/)，统一兼容入口为 https://www.aifast.hk/v1 。具体模型 ID、账号权限、端点能力和价格以当前模型页面与公告为准；目录收录不等于已完成生成、流式、工具调用或稳定性实测。

## Pages

- [AIFast service overview](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/aifast/): service scope, capabilities, Base URL, first-call workflow, verification boundaries and canonical website links.
- [Status and catalog reference](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/): current marketplace and maintenance context.
- [China access guide](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/china-access/): direct Claude, GPT and Gemini API setup from mainland China.
- [OpenAI-compatible migration](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/openai-compatible/): Python, Node.js and cURL migration plus error handling.
- [Model-check methodology](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/model-check/): evidence hierarchy and report interpretation for public HTTPS OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible gateways. A compatibility score is not proof of model identity or long-term stability.
- [Run the public check](https://docs.aifast.hk/model-check/): use a temporary limited key; the test sends real requests and may incur token charges at the target gateway.
- [Start by task](https://docs.aifast.hk/start/): choose a first-call, endpoint-check, migration, multimodal or enterprise workflow.
- [Codex custom provider setup](https://docs.aifast.hk/tools/codex/): current config.toml, Responses API, Base URL and environment-key guidance.
- [Codex gateway validation](https://docs.aifast.hk/troubleshooting/codex-gateway-checklist/): Responses events, tool calls, context compaction and thread-resume checks.
- [Website report interpretation](https://docs.aifast.hk/guides/model-check-report-guide/): explains model listing, response model, random nonce, token totals and failed checks without requiring a download.
- [Claims and evidence](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/evidence/): source links, review date and scope boundaries.
- [Model directory](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/models/): selected current IDs.
- [Tool setup](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/guide/): Cursor, Dify and compatible clients.
- [FAQ](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/faq/): authentication and model troubleshooting.
- [Options comparison](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/compare/): official, aggregated and self-hosted API access.
- [AIFast Developer Hub](https://github.com/KKWANG4444/aifast-developer-hub): repository-level technical map connecting the online checker, troubleshooting and client guides.

This reference is maintained by the operator of AIFast. Product capabilities are first-party statements. Deployment decisions should also use current terms and real requests from the target environment.
